run_plot_vision_cli: run the plot_vision CLI module with --blocks flag to visualize block and depth data from binary files
run_plot_vision_with_img: run plot_vision with --blocks and --img flags to overlay an image alongside block and depth visualizations
run_plot_vision_with_visdom: run plot_vision with --visdom flag to stream visualizations to a Visdom server instead of matplotlib
run_plot_vision_save_output: run plot_vision with --out_path flag to save the generated visualization plot to a file
run_plot_vision_custom_size: run plot_vision with --size width height flags to specify custom dimensions for reshaping block data
